request.body:
## Result and scope

Refs #14

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/14#issuecomment-6825197499, session `ADB991-claude-20261112-d05c`
- Unit IDs or other outputs: `blueprint/interfaces/reviews/rank-determinant-stress-lean-ADB991.md` (new file only; the reviewed note is not edited)
- Human contributors and agent assistance: ADB991 (account holder). Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission. Three subagents each checked one contract by reading source; the parent agent rechecked the definite findings by hand.

This is an independent Lean-correspondence review of `blueprint/interfaces/rank-determinant-stress.md` (PR #31), content SHA-256 `a7477c98…2555`. The review is from a non-author account. **Outcome: changes requested, no acceptance.**

Definite findings:
- The statement the note gives for `Org.Commission.picks` is actually that of `Acme.glistens`.
- `annular_fieldA`, `tenet` and `shells_law` take extraction, hierarchy and derivative-plan hypotheses beyond `Aroma`. This affects the proposed PU-20a boundary.
- The note omits the hypothesis `0 ≤ generator` and the output `DiffPlan` of `Accent.rated`.
- In `Scotia`, the `step` field holds for all `N, p` (the note puts it under "eventually"), and the eventual field also contains `Mark.Symmetry`.
- The note omits hypotheses of `reception` and `castle`, and misstates the per-order conclusion of `uv_log`.
- `Rank.determinant`, `Soft.coupon` and `Ship.banking` have further callers that the "one consumer" claims miss (`Array.postage`, and callers in `MergeProof/West`).

Confirmed:
- Contract A statements, exactly as written.
- Contract A non-reachability, by a sound import-graph argument.
- `Maxwell.Ranks` is a complex linear equivalence, which settles a point the note left open.
- The named call chains.
- The note's open question about which `Maxwell.Ranks` is used downstream: on the `SharpGram.coordination` and `xanadu` routes it is the one from `Climb.comparison`. The equivalence in `rated`'s output is not consumed.

Open questions Q1–Q4 are recorded. The main one (Q1) asks whether `emanate` reaches PU-11/PU-12 through `West/Equity`/`West/Tael`.

- Commands actually run and results:

- Checks not performed and why: no Lean elaboration and no compiled-graph closure. The sandbox cannot reach the Mathlib cache, the Mathlib repository or the prebuilt release. The pinned toolchain was installed, but `lake` could not fetch dependencies. The note's [E]/[G] claims were checked against source text only, and theorem counts were not checked.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: none. This PR is a review record only.
